## Learning Objectives

- Apply the following dplyr functions: `filter()`, `group_by()`, `summarize()`, `count()`, `mutate()`
- Understand R logical operators to filter data
- Break down coding problems into steps before writing code
- Chain commands using the pipe (written as `|>` or `%>%`) and recognize mistakes to avoid
